title: What Killing Your Sin Actually Means for a Godly Man
caption:
White-knuckling gets you through Tuesday. It doesn't touch Wednesday.

Scripture doesn't say manage your flesh. It says put it to death. That's not gritting your teeth harder, it's cutting the supply line, replacing the empty hour with something that actually feeds you, and saying it out loud to one man before it can hide again.

Willpower manages sin. Confession is the kill shot.
